title: Audit European language-position index ownership
changes: Document the conditional source ownership of both original language-position readers for every byte-sized index without imposing a new guest limit.
validation: Static E164 audit s7fuvptv authenticates the EUR ROM, original reader instructions and source literals. Its 512 logical pair reads map to 261 physical pairs: ten language-position pairs, 29 existing static OBJ pairs and 222 unbound pairs.
limitations: Only values 0 through 4 have ordinary publication witnesses. Inputs above 4 and the independent meanings of adjacent bytes remain unproved; no additional source owner or runtime change is claimed. Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
